api_key_env.description: Environment variable name that contains the OpenAI API key.

embedding_dimensions.description: Override embedding vector dimensions reported by the model handle.

base_url.description: Override the API base URL (default: https://api.openai.com/v1). Set this to target an OpenAI-compatible server such as OpenRouter, vLLM, LM Studio, or Ollama. Should include the version path segment (e.g. /v1).
